mentions.name: hilbert-qusim
mentions.description: A quantum simulator written in C++ from scratch without using any external libraries, implementing its own lazy evaluation structure, eigen solvers, and other core components. Currently a work in progress.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on a quantum simulator written in C++ from scratch. I’m not using any external library, so I had to implement everything from the lazy eval structure to the eigen solvers and so on. It’s still very a WIP, but here’s the repo: https://github.com/braketware/hilbert-qusim
